newsitem.title: JAPAN: Powerful typhoon heads for southern Japan.
newsitem.headline: Powerful typhoon heads for southern Japan.

text.p: A powerful typhoon with winds of more than 100 miles per hour (160 kph) was headed for southern Japan on Monday, and ships in the area have been warned of mounting waves, Japan's Meteorological Agency said.
An agency statement said the 24th typhoon of the present season was at present about 1,350 km (850 miles) southwest of Tokyo and heading for Japan's southernmost island of Okinawa.
The statement said that if the typhoon continues on its present course, it would strike the islands early on Tuesday morning.
The agency warned ships in the area that waves had mounted to more than six metres (yards) and were likely to become much higher.
